title: Descent and test-morphism comparison for fpqc-compatible labelled clopen partitions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\{f_i:U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], with $I$ an arbitrary set. Let $A$ be a set, possibly empty. For every $i$ let $\rho_i:|U_i|\to A$ be a function whose fibres $\rho_i^{-1}(a)$ are open for every $a\in A$. Write $p_i,p_j$ for the projections from $U_i\times_XU_j$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Assume $\rho_i\circ|p_i|=\rho_j\circ|p_j|$ for every $i,j$. There is a unique family $(Z_a)_{a\in A}$ of pairwise disjoint open and closed subsets of $|X|$ with $\bigcup_{a\in A}Z_a=|X|$ and $f_i^{-1}(Z_a)=\rho_i^{-1}(a)$ for every $i,a$. Give each $Z_a$ its open subscheme structure [def-weil-open-immersion]. Moreover, for any scheme morphism $h:V\to X$ and any function $\sigma:|V|\to A$, if $\rho_i\circ|q_i|=\sigma\circ|q_V|$ on every $U_i\times_XV$ (where $q_i$ and $q_V$ are the two projections), then $h^{-1}(Z_a)=\sigma^{-1}(a)$ for every $a$. In particular the fibres of $\sigma$ are open and closed. Neither $I$ nor $A$ is assumed finite, and $X$ need not be quasi-compact.
